venue.name: 402 Courts & Spaces
venue.description: Demo venue — edit config/inventory.json to describe your real rentable inventory.

items.name: Tennis Court 1
items.description: Outdoor hard court with floodlights. Nets and line judges' chairs included.
items.terms: Court time starts and ends on the block. Leave the surface swept. Floodlights cut out at closing.

items.name: Tennis Court 2
items.description: Outdoor hard court, no floodlights — daylight bookings only in winter.
items.terms: Court time starts and ends on the block. Leave the surface swept.

items.name: Rehearsal Studio A
items.description: 40 m² sprung floor, mirrored wall, PA and upright piano.
items.terms: Sound curfew after 21:00. Reset the room: chairs stacked, floor swept, PA powered down.

items.name: Meeting Room 1
items.description: Seats 8. 55" display with HDMI and USB-C, whiteboard, kettle.
items.terms: Wipe the whiteboard and take rubbish with you. Overruns are billed as new blocks.

items.name: Mobile Espresso Cart
items.description: Two-group machine, grinder, 20 kg of beans, wheels. Requires a 13A socket.
items.terms: Return backflushed and empty. Damage or missing parts are charged at replacement cost.

items.name: Portable PA Rig
items.description: 2×12" active tops, 15" sub, 8-channel desk, stands and cabling.
items.terms: Return coiled and in the flight case. Damage or missing parts are charged at replacement cost.

policy.description: A quote is a signed, time-limited price for a specific item and window. Reserving costs $0.02 and issues an access code valid for the booked window. Reservations are non-refundable inside 1 hour of the start; earlier cancellations release the block free of charge.
